source: 2026-10-20 user-authorized Discover staggered card deck and approximately one-third-width skip gesture; not an exact third-party app clone
approved_deltas: Three stable-ID card nodes, rear cards slightly rotated in opposite directions with visible side/bottom corners; existing user photos, typography, copy, CTA and Tabbar unchanged.
Reserve 14 source CSS pixels (26.718rpx) inside the card region for rear corners; front card remains at most 542 source CSS pixels and shrinks with available height. No vertical browsing.

Tags wrap naturally at the actual card width rather than using a combined-character-count heuristic. All three complete values stay within the front card; no smaller type, shortened copy or clipped last pill.

Release at approximately one third of measured card width advances exactly once in either direction. A 1 CSS-coordinate-pixel tolerance handles WebKit integer client coordinates; no velocity-only shortcut. Smaller gestures spring back.
Pointer capture retains the drag outside the card. Only the primary pointer starts a drag; cancellation, vertical gestures, multitouch and right mouse input do not navigate or advance.

Coalesce movement into animation frames; flush the final release sample. Reuse the incoming card DOM/photo node across promotion. Horizontal/limited vertical translation and rotation stay compositor-friendly.
Browsing is transient UI state only. No Store writes, skipped-user ledger, like, request, relation, balance or quota changes. Detail and primary CTA still reference the current canonical user ID.
consumers: DiscoverProfileCard only used by Discover index

interaction.source_screen: HTML Photo plus user-authorized swipe increment
interaction.trigger: Primary pointer down, move, up, cancel/lost capture
interaction.preconditions: Visible person and ready account, no navigation/settling, valid positive measured card width
interaction.visible_feedback: Follow finger; next card lifts and straightens continuously; release advances at 1/3 or springs back
interaction.success_result: One next canonical entity per completed swipe, both directions browse forward; no accidental profile click
interaction.failure_result: Cancel/below-threshold/vertical/multiple-pointer gesture retains current entity; hide/unmount clears captures, RAF and timers
interaction.persistence: none; card index is UI state in the current page instance
interaction.sync_scope: Card, detail and CTA read the same current Store entity; user filtering retains current visible ID or resets safely
interaction.acceptance: Threshold boundary on multiple widths, mouse/touch capture, interrupted gestures, rapid repeats, incoming-node reuse, small safe-area screens, detail return, unchanged saved business state; browser and bundled WKWebView
